intro: The Hunt Continues is an early rite of passage assigned by Grull Hawkwind in Camp Narache. It tasks aspiring hunters with gathering mountain cougar pelts from the southern hills to clothe the tribe's children and mend their tents.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: A traveler skilled in the ways of the hunt knows that his prey is not for mere trophy. The beasts of the plains provide us with a means of survival. You will make quite an impression on the elders if you can bring back some highly valued Mountain Cougar Pelts. You can find the beasts lurking in the hills to the south.
Our children need clothing and our tents need mending.

clips.title: Progress
paras: If you can provide pelts for the tribe I will pass word along to my father, Chief Hawkwind, of your generous deeds.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The traveler of Narache thank you for these provisions, friend. With your skill in the ways of the hunt you will surely be revered in Thunder Bluff someday.
